scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n "backend,frontend" -c "magenta,cyan" "composer --working-dir=backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.dev:artisan: concurrently -k -n "backend,frontend" -c "magenta,cyan" "php backend/artisan serve" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.dev:npm: concurrently -k -n "backend,frontend" -c "magenta,cyan" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
